notes.title: HAPPY BIRTHDAY ! - Anniversary Update
notes.notes:
Hi ! I hope you are all doing great ! Pure Rock Crawling is celebrating its 6th birthday !

First things first, a few improvements to the gameplay. Thanks to everybody who caught a few things that were not right with the tutorial. Several things piled up and caused problems in completing the tutorial and proceeding to the game:

 When resetting location to the trailer a reference to the vehicle was being lost, that caused inability to complete other tasks. That is now fixed. 
 You couldn't access the garage if the previous notification window was not closed/confirmed. It is fixed now.
 Also discovering the trailer required engaging with it to proceed - that seemed unnecessary so it now only requires discovering it. 

To avoid these situations in the future, you can now skip the tutorial completely while starting a new game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32409027/0cab31f1d7162bdbe8ca42b8935ef1045e1f384a.png
If you happen to find any other issues please let me know in the forums. 

There are several known issues that I am currently working on, like (but not limited to) vehicles losing power when turning left, weak brakes and other gamepad/wheel related bugs. This should be temporarily fixed but I am in the middle of reworking the whole system for binding steering wheel inputs as it has a conflict with the gamepad inputs causing bugs like these. So the fix should be here soon. As of right now, you might need to rebind your wheel inputs for: steering, throttle, brake and clutch. Apologies for the inconvenience.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32409027/6f3d2a5a11eeb97a96889fcbdd1d88155dd1b4cb.png

Alongside the above mentioned fixes I am working on a new map. It's coming along nicely, but still needs some work.

To sum up, this was quite a year. From drivetrain and physics updates that improved the simulation side of gameplay, through new challenges, missions, garage for modifying your trucks, to a new map. Everything topped with the complete redesign of the UI. I am very happy with every improvement and will work hard to add more. I know that not every aspect of the game works for everyone but I am reading all of your reports, issues and suggestions. Thanks to you Pure Rock Crawling is constantly evolving into a better game, big thanks ! I am going straight back to work on the next update, stay tuned !

Cheers and take care !

notes.title: GENERAL UPDATE
notes.notes:
Hi ! I hope you are all doing well ! Although, this update took more time to develop than expected, it brings many improvements and new elements to Pure Rock Crawling.

Let's run through these changes :)


 Graphical improvements
Earlier, the game used a very unoptimized sharpening material in the post-process. This resulted in not as sharp textures and blurring behind the moving vehicle. The new method, which is more engine based, improved greatly looks of the game and gave it much more refined look
 New UI
Whole game UI was redone. The purpose was mainly to fix the issues that you might have encountered while switching between the input devices. The other benefit of this change is the new, refreshed look of all the menus in the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32409027/40e4d81c3df9fa5b3633139df175b28141cb167c.png
After the implemented changes, the buttons stay in focus for the device. This fixes the lost input problem where you weren't able to select any button. Moreover, the whole loop of menus and interact widgets was reorganized and therefore leads to much more fluid gameplay. Now you don't have to back out to the main menu whenever you want to go back to options menu.
 Garage
Implementing this feature took a while, but I am so happy how it turned out. You now have access to the garage, which is placed on the main maps and marked on mini map, too.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32409027/c46c9b7053ea9083c75aea9c73c7b5156901aaf6.png
The garage is your hub and access point to the customization and vehicle selection menu. It also gives you the option to fast travel between the maps. Again, the garage greatly improves the gameplay by not having to quit the game to main menu to change your vehicle or select a map. Hope you will like it :)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32409027/29fb971f8b9c5e369adac926c90240c2f7e64a85.png
 Travel points
Switching between the maps is now integrated into the level design. Inspired by US National Parks' entrances, now you can simply drive to the end of the map and will be presented with the map selection.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32409027/90bf6fd5d6540e39e983b2920a48687a817ac079.png
 Physics
As always there is something to improve with the physics system. The newest changes eliminate shaky wheels when not driving. Also, the whole physics simulation now runs smoother and faster. This also eliminated bugs with tires glitching into the terrain when they were changed in the customization menu.
 Options
Alongside UI update, the options menu got solid rework. The wheel configuration was separated for more clarity and easier setup. Again, all of the UI elements now keep track of your input and result in smooth navigation.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32409027/c8ef3b98224554067afa156068135f076475396f.png
 Other 

 fixed lag spike on startup
 fixed collisions having wrong properties on the Winter map, resulting in lag spikes on smaller rocks
 fixed unnecessary assets being packaged with shipping build of the game, resulting in 50% game file reduction
 fixed loosing input from steering wheel and other devices
 tutorial is now updated with the new systems and features (if you want to rerun tutorial you have to delete tutorial save file from the game save directory)
 multiplayer is now moved to separate build (available in beta tab in steam game properties). I hope to get back to it in the future and make it more playable. Sadly, as of right now it blocks further development of the game as it interferes too much with current changes (especially wheel support) causing a whole bunch of bugs. For now, it is too hard to keep it updated and work on these things simultaneously.
 desert map is currently not playable, I was trying to save it but for now it does not work with recent changes, newly implemented features and graphical improvements. It will see a rework in the foreseeable future.


Hope you like the changes. There is still a lot to come :) As always, if you have any issues or suggestions, please write it down in the forums ! See you in the next update !

notes.title: CHALLENGES UPDATE
notes.notes:
Hi ! I hope you are all doing great ! Updated challenge system is here !

But first, HAPPY NEW YEAR !!!!! I wish you all the best and at the same time I would like to thank you for all the support you give me ! Pure Rock Crawling has just passed 1000 reviews :O This is a huge news for me, as a solo developer, and it is quite overwhelming ! 

As for the update, for the long time there was no clarity in what player should do in free roam. There were challenge boards which activated selected trails but that required a lot of travel with no purpose. This update changes that into much more player friendly system.

Now, heading to the challenge board will gain you access to actual challenges, composed of selected trails, with different obstacles to tackle. This will be the core of progressing in Pure Rock Crawling. In the future there will be more challenges added that will enhance the gameplay experience with more activities.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32409027/3af457723fd1821ed12fe5f32ff9e2678b6a7402.png

As for free roam gameplay, there is a massive change in selecting desired trails. You can now simply drive to the trail head and select type of challenge as you please. This way you don't have to drive to challenge board every time you want to activate a trail challenge. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32409027/f6cc0b0ef79b14392688f12b7803233d26d07d52.png

Every available trail head is now marked on the minimap with a cross.

This new system utilizes new UI method of detecting player input, this fixes the problems with lost gamepad focus and overlaying input from mouse and gamepad. This is a work in progress and it will see another updates that add to the gameplay experience.

Thanks again for the support, and as always, if you have any issues with the update, please write in the forums. Even if something is not changed right away i want to assure you that I keep track of everything posted there. It is just not possible for me to work on everything at once ;) Hope you understand.

Have fun with new challenges and take care !

notes.title: DRIVETRAIN UPDATE
notes.notes:
Hi ! I hope you are all doing well ! This update focuses on 3 things, input, UI and drivetrain.

Lets start with drivetrain update. Since drivetrain in Pure Rock Crawling is fully physical simulation, which means both torque applied to the differential and difflock can be controlled separately for front and rear. It is direct influence from few updates ago where I reworked the whole system. But until now there was only four wheel drive and difflock on or off for both axles. With today's update you can now disengage 4x4 and remain in 2x4 drive with rear wheels being driven. Additionally you can choose to lock diffs both for front and rear independently. This truly shows the physical simulation behind these systems :)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32409027/3144f52aa992f6e3b53ff201c28b013ca1b28370.png
Adding these options required some improvements in the UI to show the player current status of the drivetrain. So I added whole new UI to the game showing what is currently engaged and whats not. Adding to this I cleaned up the gearbox widget and moved the pitch/roll indicator to make it more clear to read.

Lastly I added indicators of what your key bindings currently are to avoid being confused about what button lock which diff :) Also If you are controller player, UI will show separate icons for gamepad.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32409027/573a8ee79c51ebecba67177556700e194d823756.png



*IMPORATNT* for keyboard players

You may encounter problems with key bindings. It could show as having multiple functions attached to one key. To remedy this you may have to delete this file (to be safe make a backup copy of it): 

%LOCALAPPDATA% \PureRockCrawling\Saved\Config\WindowsNoEditor\input.ini



Full update list:

 fixed reverse being overpowered and with no engine sounds
 fixed gearbox loosing gear after crash
 ability to change 4x4 to 2x4
 separate difflock control
 UI improvements
 tire grip tweaks
 UI key mapping hints
 improvemed gamepad UI settings

As always, if you have any problems or suggestions, let me know in the forums !

Take care and have fun !

notes.title: SUSPENSION UPDATE
notes.notes:
Hi ! I hope you are all doing great ! Smaller update with some fixes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32409027/5ea8557390fe00723c1584aedd56473e45e9f070.png

Follow up to the previous update. For each suspension there are additional parameters that determine how it behaves. For example suspensions with Panhard bar will have a side to side movement depending on suspension compression. It generated a lot physics calculations and was quite heavy in terms of computing. 

So I worked with the code behind suspension physics, cleaned it up and made more lightweight. That should hopefully resolve stability issues. Also now ride height preset by lift kit doesn't affect side to side movement, as if you would adjust Panhard bar to not have axle on one side sticking out to far. 

Also worked on few parameters regarding synchronization in multiplayer.

Thanks for the help and if you have any issues with suspension, post it on the forums !

Cheers !

notes.title: HAPPY BIRTHDAY ! - Anniversary Update
notes.notes:
Hi ! I hope you are all well ! Pure Rock Crawling is celebrating 5th birthday !

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32409027/23ae441b7e42a91f5604b4192dc885f2302041e1.png

In this update I have addressed a few things that were quite frustrating to deal with for a long time.
First, the tire grip. Before, the main factors defining tires were mass, contact surface, and dimensions, while physical material was always the same. It was not by my urge or purpose to make things simple, but the logic behind such physical tires' behavior was much more complicated at the time. Finally, I came up with a suitable solution to the problem. Now, each tire is categorized with its performance on snow/sand, gravel/road, or rocks. For now, the tire performance is represented in customization menu and will be better visualized later. Second, tires' physics has been also improved, resulting in much better stability at higher speeds.

Suspension characteristics have been also enhanced. Now, every suspension type behaves like it should, with things like the Panhard bars pushing axle side to side and links arrangement making difference to the stability. Alongside this change, the suspension physics are also improved giving better feel and more realistic response.

The engine, gearbox, throttle response, and power curves have been adjusted to sound and perform better. Now, the vehicles change the gears in the auto mode more realistically, sound better, and can drive faster. Also, the new throttle curve allows for a smoother start.

As for the anniversary,
Thanks for the amazing five years ! The way this game evolved during this time is far beyond what i have expected it to be. If anyone is wondering why it is still in Early Access, it is because the scope of the game grew and grew. it was never my intention for it to be this big. Yeah, it could be finished in its original form from 2018 in a year or so. However, having such and an amazing community around who wanted this game to look better and play better, I could not do that. I want this game to be the best I can do, so if that means more time in EA, I am all for it. It just means more updates for you ;) That is not to say, I want it to be stuck in EA forever. I will do my best to finish this game as quickly as I can, but this has to be done step by step and in a manner that will not harm the quality :)

Thanks again ! Cheers !

notes.title: HAPPY BIRTHDAY ! - customization update
notes.notes:
Hi ! I hope you are all well ! Pure Rock Crawling is celebrating 3rd birthday ! To celebrate this, all remodeled vehicles are getting new parts for visual customization !

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32409027/fb12bca078ab4723adbb37bd2db3ac7c0f4d97d1.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32409027/1ebfae276426600dc282cabad9e99d11030a9565.jpg

So one year ago I wrote this:

"And for the future plans, first lets take a look at what i wrote a year ago:

update car models, as well as suspension, i think i can do much better now
rework customization, I want to make something that would really let you feel like building dream rock crawler. Different tire sizes/types, axles that actually change something, being able to chose between spring or leaf suspension, more cosmetic items etc., so that's something that i want to work hard on.
different progression system, since i find levels/credits in current form a little annoying
multiplayer and mod support, so these are the tough ones. Don't get me wrong, I want both in game as soon as possible ! Both require the game to be more finished than it is right now (especially mod support) so first things first. Once i settle on how the core mechanics work, I will start working on these features. Cant say anything for sure but I will try as hard as i can :)
So yeah, I am quite happy with the progress! I think that besides smaller updates you have suggested, one of the important things will be adding more maps. Join me in the next 12 months of updates ! :)"

And I am still happy with the progress, I didn't even thought that multiplayer would be possible, sure it is in beta and have its issues but still, huge milestone for me. Along with the other things like new menu, improved tire physics, decals, manual gearbox, trailer - which were all impossible for me to even think of when I first released the game. 

That's all thanks to you and your support which is incredible. Hope you'll all stick around for another 12 months !

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32409027/be9d42abc75c5e1dbdb71749af22884896b7a9e6.jpg

So, let's make a new list for me to check in the next year:

 improve multiplayer experience
 add more customization elements
 new cars
 new map
 more gameplay elements / different progression system
 fixing bugs mentioned in the forums, regarding steering wheels, UI navigation etc.
 mod support, still tough one and highly unlikely but definitely worth trying and looking for solution to make it happen

Take care and have fun !

 Increased friction of the rocks on the winter map, turned out that there was a problem related to how collisions are setup on the test maps' rocks. Now all good :)

Have fun !

Hi ! Time to adres few things in the vehicle physics, including one of the most requested one - vehicle speed. Let's get to it !

So, since day one the vehicle speeds were limited, or even got slower as the updates were rolling and whole car physics model was becoming more complicated. Increasing speed resulted in very floaty physics and collision problems. Since the vehicles are made in a unique way, not relying on the default ray-cast method, the game engine was struggling. Also tires are very different from what you can find in other games and are really pushing the engine limits. 

Every time when working on update I was trying to fix all of this, and finally I was able to !

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32409027/8899a2f9f04c39dc09f931d235ef77b0e5283c3c.jpg

Now the physics feel more agile, vehicles can go faster and the physics are more stable - resulting in much more realistic experience !

Big thanks to the community for all of the suggestions ! Now you will be able to reach your favorite locations much faster :)

I hope you will like the changes ! Stay tuned for the next update !

Hi ! Here we are, one year later :) Time to sum up past 12 months and plan the future ! But first, the actual update :)

GRAPHICS UPDATE
I took some time to rework the lighting on all maps, to better suit the overall look of the game. I hope the game now feels more toned down and much more realistic :) As I was changing this stuff I went ahead and change some vegetation on spring maps, as much as I am in new maps I think that the game really will benefit from this change and help the old maps not stand out so much.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32409027/4c52807947cb61f77a03a307d6ab059475b12d14.jpg

MINOR UPDATES

 car physics should be more responsive now, there was linear drag applied to car body causing it to "float" when moving faster.
 improved camera, I hope it will help everyone who felt dizzy while playing
 fixed bug that caused no feedback from buttons on score widget
 more CPU calculations for body velocity and position, should improve smoothness
 fixed bug that caused no money earned from the first ever stage
 more money for clean stage completion


And now... lets sum up this year !

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32409027/4f677783e38bf83a94341451fa05db38283206c0.jpg

I have never thought that this game is going to evolve so much, that it would have customization, wheel support with force feedback, proper cockpit view and if you are here from day one then probably you remember the struggle to make proper diff lock :)

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32409027/8a57d5d9a6084d62a904c538897d2c970407da92.jpg

And that's all thanks to all of you. Pushing me to make new things, fix the old ones, really that means a lot. I may be not the most communicative dev, but i hope you feel that i am reading every suggestion and comment, and that i am truly committed to this as an Early Access where players have impact on the game.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32409027/3475c8cea8b56f2c010bec43f277041b3b7d48f4.jpg

As for the future :) I have some ideas that I am constantly testing and also your requests. So here is the rough list of what to expect from this game in the future:


 update car models, as well as suspension, i think i can do much better now
 rework customization, I want to make something that would really let you feel like building dream rock crawler. Different tire sizes/types, axles that actually change something, being able to chose between spring or leaf suspension, more cosmetic items etc., so that's something that i want to work hard on.
 different progression system, since i find levels/credits in current form a little annoying
 multiplayer and mod support, so these are the tough ones. Don't get me wrong, I want both in game as soon as possible ! Both require the game to be more finished than it is right now (especially mod support) so first things first. Once i settle on how the core mechanics work, I will start working on these features. Cant say anything for sure but I will try as hard as i can :)
Looking back on how much Pure Rock Crawling changed in the past 12 months i am sure there is much more to come !!!

Thank you all for the support ! Cheers and have fun !

Hi ! Just finished working on newest update, which was meant to be a lot smaller but i just got carried away :) To be honest, working on this game is getting better and better with each update. Overcoming problems that I felt were impossible to solve at the beginning of this journey, feels just awesome and makes me wanna do more and more ! :)

Ok so, in today's update :

KEY BINDINGS

Sorry to keep you waiting so long ;) 

CAR DAMAGE SYSTEM

This is just early test so don't expect to much :) I hope it will make you be more careful drivers, for now it is just cosmetic.

REWORKED CAR ENGINE PHYSICS

So, before this update, differential lock was jumping between two systems. One made for locked diffs which was giving the wheels a specific angle to be at the given time. Second for open ones, giving the specific angular velocity. This was very imperfect, but i just couldn't make my mind which will be better in the long run. With this update i made my mind and went for the first one. This required some tricky calculations to make the car behave naturally but gave me full control, power, load, gears. Now the system is more complete with: working automatic gearbox, exhaust smoke reacting to engine load, and low range being more powerful.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32409027/15e78eb3324e70599210b402145620411a13f91b.jpg

NEW CAMERA SYSTEM

The new 3rd person camera system is making looking around and keeping the eye on the track easier because of moving pivot point. Now you don't have to scroll the mouse wheel all the time. If you look from the above system is trying to put the car near border of the screen so you can see where you are going. Looking from front also makes more space in front of the car. Side effect of this system are of course killer screenshots ! :)

Alongside working on 3rd person camera, I made possible moving the head around in the 1st person view, and as community suggested (thanks all for great suggestion !), you can look out through the window !

    Vehicle has more power
    Tire spin now possible (tire upgrades in the future will make sense now)

notes.notes:
Hi, first of all, BIG THANKS for the support you guys showed in the last couple of days ! I am happy that you are enjoying the game so far :) Last days i was working to bring most urgent hot-fixes:


    Score UI change - more readable with grey background
    Volume control added in option menu
    Added camera invert option checkbox in option menu
    Gates at level 4 stage 3 should be fine now
    Game launching in VR should be ok now
    Improved throttle response in trucks


In the next update i will focus more on suggestions e.g. too bouncy suspension, cockpit view etc. 
I also started working on customization, so stay tuned ;)
